ops:
We're gathered here in memory
of a great man...

Although he adopted the callsign 'Hawk',
James Stern was not a vicious man.

Despite the dangerous occupation he
chose for himself...

...he did his best to bring dignity and
honor to a treacherous world.

Like the hawk, Stern rose above the
limitations of those mired below...

...and we must strive to reach the
heights he attained.

And rest assured, the Wildcats will
never abandon your lofty ideals.
